senses.gloss: m. (corius, corium) leather, skin, bark; כלי ק׳ leather garments, working clothes.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 17:1:7">Y. Sabb. XVII, 16ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מהו לטלטל כ׳ ק׳ וכ׳</he> is it permitted to handle working garments on the Sabbath? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49">Gen. R. s. 49</cite>, beg. <he>שמותם … לכ׳ ק׳ וכ׳</he> the names of the wicked are like leather garments; as long as you use them, they wear well; when you let them lie, they rot.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:17">Koh. R. to II, 17</cite> <he>נתעטף בכ׳ ק׳ שלו</he> he wrapped himself in his working clothes.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 29:4">Deut. XXIX, 4</cite>) (<cite ref="K00703"><he>כלום</he></cite>) <he>כ׳ ק׳ וכ׳</he> were leather garments carried with the Israelites out of Egypt (that they did not wear out)?; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:11">Cant. R. to IV, 11</cite>; Pesik. B’shall., p. 92ᵃ, a.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 850:3">Yalk. Deut. 850</cite> <cite ref="S00604"><he>קוריות</he></cite> (read: <he>קוֹרְיוּם</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 691">Yalk. Ps. 691</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 23">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIII</cite> <cite ref="S00609"><he>קוריים</he></cite> (ed. Bub. <he>קואים</he>, read: <he>קוריום</he>).—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> Ar.; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:11">Esth. R. to I, 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00609"><he>קוֹרִיִּים</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11">Koh. R. to III, 11</cite> <he>שפעת ק׳</he>, read: <he>קוֹרִים</he>, v. <cite ref="U01790"><he>שִׁפְעָה</he> I</cite>, a. <cite ref="S00586"><he>קוֹרָה</he> III</cite>.]
